meta.title: Home
meta.description: Wedding suites, business cards and limited-edition broadsides, set by hand and printed on a vintage press.

hero.heading: Cards, invitations and broadsides, set by hand
hero.lead: Quillfeather prints every job one sheet at a time, from metal and wood type on a press older than the building.

image.alt: A cast-iron letterpress with a locked chase of type beside a stack of cream paper

sections.heading: How a job is printed
paragraphs: We set the type, ink the plate, and pull each impression by hand. A short run takes a few days; a wedding suite takes a few weeks.
Every sheet is checked against the proof before it leaves the press.

meta.title: Services
meta.description: Three services of the studio: wedding suites, business cards and broadsides, with typical timings.

items.name: Wedding suites
items.text: Invitations, reply cards and envelopes, designed with you and printed in one or two colours.

items.name: Business cards
items.text: Thick cotton stock, deep impression, edges painted by hand on request.

items.name: Broadsides
items.text: Limited editions of a poem or a quotation, numbered and signed.

image.alt: A shallow wooden drawer of metal type sorted by size
